column1: # Which of the 39 catalogued clips reach the product, and which do not.
# Every clip is listed. Nothing is silently dropped — a map that only shows the
# hits reads as "we used everything", and we used about a third.
# verdict   ATTACH  the clip belongs to an experience that already exists
#           NEW     in scope, and seed_catalog.sql creates the experience
#           SKIP    reason in the last column
# target    exact experiences.name for ATTACH and NEW. Name is the key because
#           experiences have no slug and a uuid in a review diff tells you
#           nothing.
# Two rules decided the SKIPs, and both are about not lying to a judge:
#   1. OUT OF SCOPE — the demo is Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka. Filing a Miyazaki
#      gorge under "Osaka" would put it in an Osaka day's walking cluster and
#      the planner would route someone 900km for lunch.
#   2. UNPLACEABLE — the catalog itself says the venue is not identifiable.
#      An experience row needs a real point on a real map; inventing
#      coordinates for "an R&B bar in Tokyo" is the single most embarrassing
#      thing this app could do on stage. These are not lost — run
#      scripts/ingest_places.py or search the creator's profile for the venue
#      tag, then move the row up to NEW.
